description: Native Vulkan ICD bootstrap. Vulkan objects and commands retain their standard C ABI; NVIDIA.R4D owns hardware.

functions.name: open

parameters.name: runtime
parameters.description: Native kernel tables. Only their immutable addresses may be retained.

operation.ownership: No device, instance or caller buffer is retained. The imported R4VK generation must remain loaded while using its entrypoints or objects.

functions.description: Bind the native platform and obtain the standard ICD entrypoints. Idempotent for the same boot tables. Does not create a Vulkan instance/device or claim GPU support.

types.name: R4VkRuntime
types.description: Native platform binding. Pass addresses of actual kernel-owned tables, never copies or caller-local wrappers.

types.name: R4VkLoader

fields.name: negotiate_loader_icd
fields.description: PFN_vkNegotiateLoaderICDInterfaceVersion. Native supported negotiation versions are 1 through 7; version 0 is rejected.

fields.name: get_instance_proc_addr
fields.description: PFN_vkGetInstanceProcAddr using the ordinary Vulkan x86_64 C ABI.

fields.name: get_physical_device_proc_addr
fields.description: PFN_GetPhysicalDeviceProcAddr from the standard Vulkan ICD ABI.

types.description: Borrowed entrypoint addresses from this R4VK generation. Negotiate before creating instances; query Vulkan functions and capabilities through the standard API.

errors.description: VK_ERROR_INITIALIZATION_FAILED: unsupported descriptor or missing/incompatible platform binding; output unchanged.

ownership_rules.name: objects
ownership_rules.text: Vulkan objects, allocation callbacks and mutable runtime/compiler state belong to the creating process. Applications obey Vulkan synchronization and lifetime rules; destroy objects before discarding their library binding.

ownership_rules.name: hardware
ownership_rules.text: R4VK uses native resource/queue/VA/fence contracts. NVIDIA.R4D is the sole GPU owner. No Linux ioctl, FD, device file or host Vulkan loader is exposed as the native ABI.

ownership_rules.name: fallback
ownership_rules.text: A valid instance can enumerate zero eligible GPUs. Missing R4VK or no compatible device leaves the ordinary software-rendering fallback available. Opening the ICD does not establish device support or Vulkan conformance.
